raw.details:
About:

  • Education is evolving rapidly, but many institutions still struggle with time-consuming manual processes, fragmented communication, administrative inefficiencies, and limited access to intelligent digital tools. Paper Buddy EduVerse Hackathon 2026, organized by Paper Buddy in collaboration with DCRUST, is your opportunity to build innovative technology that can solve real-world problems and shape the future of education.
  • This hackathon invites developers, designers, innovators, and problem-solvers to create AI-powered, scalable, and production-ready software solutions for schools, colleges, universities, coaching institutes, and other educational organizations. Whether you're passionate about Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Web Development, Mobile Apps, Cloud Computing, Data Science, IoT, Cybersecurity, or UI/UX Design, this is your chance to build something meaningful with real-world impact.
  • Participants are free to choose one or multiple problem areas and combine them into a single integrated solution. Rather than building isolated features, teams are encouraged to develop comprehensive platforms that intelligently connect different educational workflows. For example, your project could integrate AI Document Reading, Smart Student Registration, Attendance Management, AI Report Card Generation, Student Performance Analytics, Fee Management, Bus Tracking, Parent Communication, AI Chat Assistants, Financial Dashboards, and much more.
  • The listed problem areas are only a starting point. We encourage participants to think beyond the provided ideas, introduce original features, explore emerging technologies, and create solutions that are practical, scalable, secure, and capable of serving thousands of educational institutions.

Official Problem Statement:

  • A detailed description of the problem domains, expectations, and challenge areas is available in the official problem statement document.
  • Please review the document before preparing your submission. While it outlines several focus areas, you are not expected to implement every feature. Participants are encouraged to select one or more relevant challenges, combine multiple modules into a cohesive solution, or even propose innovative ideas beyond the listed problem statements.

What You'll Build:

Participants can develop solutions in areas such as:

  • AI-Powered School Automation
  • Smart Academic Management
  • Parent–Teacher–Student Collaboration
  • Student Safety & Well-being
  • AI & Data Intelligence
  • Financial Technology for Education
  • Digital Productivity & School Operations

You may use any technology stack, including Flutter, React, Angular, Node.js, Python, Java, .NET, Firebase, AWS, Azure, Machine Learning frameworks, Generative AI, LLMs, IoT, RFID, Computer Vision, or any other technologies that best suit your solution.

Why Participate?

This hackathon is more than just a coding competition—it's an opportunity to build technology that can create a measurable impact in the education sector.

By participating, you will:

  • Solve genuine challenges faced by educational institutions.
  • Build a portfolio-worthy project with real-world relevance.
  • Showcase your technical and creative abilities.
  • Gain experience working on industry-scale problem statements.
  • Collaborate with talented peers and learn from other innovators.
  • Compete for internships, Pre-Placement Opportunities (PPOs), certificates, and exciting goodies.
  • Demonstrate your skills to industry professionals and academic leaders.

Whether you're a beginner looking to learn or an experienced developer ready to build something impactful, this hackathon provides a platform to innovate, experiment, and grow.

Competition Structure:

Round 1 – Idea Presentation

Teams must submit a PowerPoint Presentation (or PDF) through Unstop explaining:

  • The problem being solved
  • Proposed solution
  • Key features
  • Technology stack
  • Implementation approach

Submission Window:
15 August 2026  – 26 August 2026 

All teams that successfully submit their presentation will qualify for Round 2.

Round 2 – Project Submission

Teams must submit:

  • Complete working project
  • GitHub Repository
  • Live Demo/Application Link

Projects will be evaluated based on:

  • Innovation
  • Technical Implementation
  • Functionality
  • User Experience
  • Scalability
  • Practical Business Impact
  • Overall Solution Quality

Submission Window:
26 August 2026 – 01 September 2026 

Rewards:

  • 1st Prize – Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) + Goodies
  • 2nd Prize – Internship Opportunity
  • 3rd Prize – Internship Opportunity
  • 4th–10th Positions – Exciting Goodies
  • All Eligible Participants – Digital Participation Certificate

Whether you automate school administration, build intelligent AI assistants, improve student safety, modernize educational finance, develop advanced analytics, or create an entirely new solution that no one has imagined before—this is your opportunity to make a real impact.

Join Paper Buddy EduVerse Hackathon 2026 and create technology that empowers the next generation of education.
